name: image-grid
description: Browse images and MP4 videos as a resizable grid, with adjustable column count and persistent sorting. Built for remote and cloud development.

imageGrid.columnCount.markdownDescription: Number of columns to display in the grid. Only used when `#imageGrid.autoColumns#` is disabled.

imageGrid.autoColumns.markdownDescription: Whether to automatically adjust the number of columns based on the viewport width.

imageGrid.sortBy.markdownDescription: The property to sort images by.

imageGrid.sortAscending.markdownDescription: Whether to sort in ascending order.

imageGrid.sorting.byPathOptions.localeMa.markdownDescription: The locale matching algorithm to use. Possible values are "`lookup`" and "`best fit`".

imageGrid.sorting.byPathOptions.sensitiv.markdownDescription:
Which differences in the strings should be taken into account. Possible values are:
- "`base`": Only strings that differ in base letters compare as unequal. Examples: a ≠ b, a = á, a = A.
- "`accent`": Only strings that differ in base letters or accents compare as unequal. Examples: a ≠ b, a ≠ á, a = A.
- "`case`": Only strings that differ in base letters or case compare as unequal. Examples: a ≠ b, a = á, a ≠ A.
- "`variant`": All strings compare as unequal.

imageGrid.sorting.byPathOptions.numeric.markdownDescription: Whether numeric collation should be used, such that "`img1.jpg`" > "`img2.jpg`" > "`img10.jpg`", instead of "`img1.jpg`" > "`img10.jpg`" > "`img2.jpg`".

imageGrid.sorting.byPathOptions.caseFirs.markdownDescription: Whether upper case or lower case should sort first. Possible values are "`upper`", "`lower`" or "`false`" (use the locale's default).

imageGrid.sorting.byPathOptions.collatio.markdownDescription:
Variant collations for certain locales. Possible values include:
- "`compat`" - Arabic
- "`dict`" - Sinhala
- "`emoji`" - root
- "`eor`" - root
- "`phonebk`" - German
- "`phonetic`" - Lingala
- "`pinyin`" - Chinese
- "`reformed`" - Swedish
- "`stroke`" - Chinese
- "`trad`"
- "`zhuyin`" - Chinese

imageGrid.telemetry.isTelemetryEnabled.markdownDescription: Enable / disable telemetry for this extension. Disabled by default, and no telemetry endpoint is configured in published builds, so this setting has no effect unless you build the extension yourself with your own key. See [`telemetry.json`](https://github.com/liamjwang/vscode-image-gallery/blob/main/telemetry.json) for the event schema.

scripts.package: npm run clean && webpack --mode production --devtool hidden-source-map
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
